hook.name: EthereumWordsHook
hook.description: EthereumWordsHook is a non-upgradeable Uniswap v4 hook for Ethereum Words protocol-registered pools. It enforces immutable liquidity rules, charges fixed protocol fees using beforeSwap and afterSwap return deltas (2% on the ETH/WORDS pool and 1% on WORDS/child-token pools), tracks WORDS reserves as NFT reward weights, burns child-market WORDS fees, and distributes main-pool ETH fees between the treasury and NFT owners.
